scheme_name: Lean Season Assistance under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
other_conditions: Applicant must be an ordinarily resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.
Applicant must not be ordinarily residing in any foreign nation during the natural calamity, lean season, or fishing ban period.
Beneficiary must not be in regular service in Government/Quasi Government undertakings or be a retired government pensioner.
Benefit is not denied if the head of the family or any family member receives Old Age Pension.
Benefit is not restricted based on the type of fishing boat owned (mechanized, motorized, or traditional).
Eligibility may be further considered based on decisions taken periodically by the Governing Body of the Pondicherry Fishermen Welfare and Distress Relief Society.
benefits_summary: 5 kg of free rice and a clothing set (one quality saree with blouse, one lunghi, and one towel) per fisherman’s family during natural calamities each year.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
